title: ExperimentReport
description: The stochastic report of an experiment (docs/design/simulation_spec.md sections 6 and 8): per metric and architecture the median and the spread across seeds, with the seed count and the denominators. Reported, never gated: no test requires an ordering, a sign or an interval that includes or excludes zero. The spread is a percentile range across seeds, not a confidence interval. A type with no ledger rate is 'not_modelled', never zero.

metric.description: Path in the metrics document (schemas/metrics.schema.json); a share contributes its value.

status.description: reported: at least one seed defines the value. none_occurred: the denominator was zero in every seed (no opportunity), which is not a perfect score. not_evaluable: no rule or evidence of the type could run on the architecture, so a value would not mean 'looked and found nothing'. not_modelled: the type has no ledger rate in production runs; no number is given, never zero. not_applicable: the metric does not exist for the detector (an evidence check raises no alarm, so it has no precision and no false-alarm rate); no number, no denominator.

n_defined.description: Seeds for which the value is defined; zero unless status is reported.

lo.description: Lower end of the spread across seeds (see the report's interval).

hi.description: Upper end of the spread across seeds (see the report's interval).

denominator.description: What the denominator counts, in words; null for a value that is itself a setting-free count with no denominator.

den.description: The denominator count per seed (min, median, max over the seeds); null when the row has no denominator.

reason.description: Why the row carries no number: null for a reported row; otherwise the reason of its status (for not_applicable the text of the case, for example no contrast in this scenario).

seeds.description: The seed list of the run, in config order.

min_seeds.description: The seed minimum of the report (A103).

truth_log_hashes.description: The hash of the truth log of each seed; the same truth was shared by every architecture of the seed.

review.description: The review settings of the run (data_model.md section 7, Review step and VR-012; ledger A213 to A215): when a held or quarantined row was reviewed, and the rules rejected beyond the policy. The outcome policy itself is the same in every run. A sensitivity variant is a different report.

timing.description: next_shift_start is the default: the first staffed review point at or after the stamp, the shift starts of the roster of A201. shift_end: the end of the next shift. next_day_start: 08:00 of the next day.

reject_also.description: Rule ids rejected at review in addition to the policy (a sensitivity variant, for example VR-015 and VR-020). Empty for the default.

not_modelled.description: Error types with no ledger rate in this run (union over the seeds).

not_evaluable.description: Rules the validation could not run on this architecture, with the reason (union over the seeds).

ranks.description: Data only. Per metric, the architectures with a reported median ordered by that median (rank 1 is the smallest; equal medians share the lowest rank). A smaller or larger value is not better or worse for every metric, and no test asserts an order.
